undocumented.title: HandleInsert ignores screen XDEPT and uses the raw program parameter instead
undocumented.code_does: On insert, newEmp.WORKDEPT is assigned from the program parameter currentDepartment (line 91), not from the display field XDEPT, so any hypothetical screen value for XDEPT is silently discarded.
undocumented.why_it_matters: If the read-only enforcement on XDEPT were ever removed, a user-entered department would still be silently overridden by the caller-supplied parameter, making the behaviour non-obvious and untestable from the UI.

undocumented.title: Wrong error message returned when Job field is blank
undocumented.code_does: When XJOB is blank the function returns the string 'Phone number cannot be blank' instead of a message about the job field.
undocumented.why_it_matters: This copy-paste error will confuse users who leave the Job field empty, as they will be told to fix the phone number instead.

undocumented.title: Minimum salary band of $30,000 enforced at creation time
undocumented.code_does: GetError rejects any salary below 30000, citing a 2015-03 HR policy; no employee can be created below this threshold.
undocumented.why_it_matters: This business rule is not documented in the specification and cannot be audited for correctness or currency.

undocumented.title: Employee ID generation adds 100 to the current maximum rather than incrementing by 1
undocumented.code_does: getNewEmpId computes the next ID as max(int(empno)) + 100, meaning IDs advance in steps of 100 rather than sequentially.
undocumented.why_it_matters: This gap strategy is undocumented; it may reflect an intentional design choice or a latent bug, and the spec says only that the ID is system-generated.
